container: background-color: #1d1216; padding: 42px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #2a1a20; border: 1px solid #46303a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 26px 22px; margin: 0 0 34px
p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.9; color: #e8dcd2; margin: 0 0 18px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: text-align: center; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #c9a36a; letter-spacing: 4px; margin: 0 0 22px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8dcd2; text-align: left; margin: 26px 0 12px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #c97a86; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
blockquote: background-color: #241419; padding: 18px 22px; margin: 0 0 18px; color: #c9a36a; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.9; text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid #46303a; border-bottom: 1px solid #46303a; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
pre: background-color: #150d10; border: 1px solid #46303a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px 17px; margin: 0 0 18px; line-height: 1.6
code: color: #e8dcd2; font-size: 13px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #150d10; color: #c9a36a; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.9; color: #e8dcd2; margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #150d10; color: #c9a36a; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #46303a; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px
